summary.intent: Run the GSD manager workflow (/gsd-manager) in the cipher-box project to get a single-terminal dashboard of milestone phases, then dispatch recommended discuss/plan/execute/verify actions across phases from that dashboard.
summary.outcome: The manager loaded its workflow definition and UI brand reference, then dispatched work that updated milestone tracking (ROADMAP.md, STATE.md) plus phase-level artifacts: two new/updated research docs for phase 69 (FUSE/WinFSP Rust integration — write-plane and write-side research) and UAT/VERIFICATION docs for phase 70.1 (rotation read-plane durability and crash-resume soundness).

repo: In cipher-box, GSD phase 69 covers FUSE and WinFSP Rust integration with grant-root awareness, and produces separate write-plane vs write-side research documents.
GSD phase 70.1 covers rotation read-plane durability and deep crash-resume soundness, and is far enough along to have both UAT.md and VERIFICATION.md.
workflow: GSD manager.md dispatches discuss inline always, but plan/execute are only safe to background on Codex runtime (via spawn_agent) because Claude Code's backgrounded agents lack the Agent/Task tool needed to nest plan-checker/worktree-executor/verifier subagents — on Claude Code, plan/execute always run inline despite the 'background' framing in the objective.

Manager dashboard builds one compound 'Continue' option that bundles all recommended_actions (background plan/execute + inline verify + inline discuss) rather than presenting them as separate menu choices, to minimize prompts to the user.
Manager re-runs `gsd_run query init.manager` on every dashboard refresh to pick up on-disk state changes made by background/inline agents, rather than caching state across loop iterations.

friction: Transcript only captures the two context-file reads (manager.md, ui-brand.md) and a final files-modified list — the actual dashboard interaction, action selection, and per-phase dispatch steps aren't visible, limiting how precisely the session's decisions can be reconstructed.
open_items: Phase 69 write-plane and write-side research were produced but the files-modified list doesn't indicate the phase reached 'planned' or 'executed' status — likely still mid-pipeline.

Phase 70.1 UAT.md and VERIFICATION.md were both touched, suggesting a verify/UAT pass ran — worth confirming in STATE.md whether it passed or is still awaiting human sign-off (per existing memory, GSD's `phase uat-passed` CLI path has no handler, so confirm completion was recorded via `phase complete` workaround if applicable).
